top_signals.title: Dentsu Soken Receives Buyout Offer From Itochu; Shares Rally
top_signals.summary: Dentsu Soken Inc. said it has received a proposal from trading house Itochu Corp. to take the company private at ¥2,880 per share.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
